blocks.text: Enclave — Citimark Townhomes on a Quiet Street off 156 Street

parts.t: Enclave at Grandview
is a Citimark townhome community of 129 homes at 2979 156 Street, near the end of a no-through street in Grandview Surrey. Floor plans have two, three or four bedrooms.
The Shops at Morgan Crossing and Grandview Corners are each roughly 1 km away.
Residents share a clubhouse with a gym, a kitchen and a fireside lounge, plus a playground.
Sunnyside Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator)

items.t: Morgan Crossing and Grandview Corners, about 1 km

parts.t: Enclave floor plans come in two-, three- and four-bedroom layouts over three storeys, so sizes vary. Kitchens have granite countertops and stainless steel appliances with a gas range, and main floors have laminate flooring.

Many homes have front and rear decks, and some units have side-by-side garages. The original finishes included radiant in-floor heating. Contact Jared for the floor plan and square footage of a specific unit.
Strata Details
Enclave is registered as strata plan BCS3293. Confirm what the monthly fees include, and review the bylaws, depreciation report and recent minutes, before you buy.
Grandview Surrey draws buyers from families, professionals, and downsizers alike. Market conditions change, so review recent sales in Enclave before making an offer.

What is the typical price range for Enclave at Grandview townhomes?
Prices vary by unit and change with the market. Contact Jared for recent Enclave sales and current listings.
How large are the homes at Enclave at Grandview?
Enclave has two-, three- and four-bedroom floor plans, so sizes vary from unit to unit. Contact Jared for the exact square footage of a specific home.
Are rentals allowed at Enclave at Grandview?

Enclave (2979 156 Street, strata plan BCS3293) is a 129-home Citimark townhome complex. Under BC rules in force since November 24, 2022, no strata, including Enclave’s, may restrict long-term rentals. The strata may still have or pass a bylaw on short-term rentals. Ask for the current bylaws and strata minutes, and confirm any short-term rental rules with the strata manager before you buy.
What schools serve Enclave at Grandview?

Enclave is in the Sunnyside Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator). The area also has several private school options within a short drive.
How competitive is the Enclave market?
It varies with the market and the unit. Contact Jared for recent Enclave sales and comparable listings before you price or make an offer.
